schema.description: CrookCatcher takes an intruder selfie when someone enters a wrong PIN, pattern or password, and emails you their photo and GPS location. Free for Android.
featureList: Takes intruder selfies on wrong PIN, pattern or password
Sends pictures and GPS location to email
Show fake home screen to fool thieves
Upload all pictures and videos to Google Drive

blog.metaTitle: Guides and Tutorials • CrookCatcher Anti-Theft App
blog.metaDescription: Practical guides to protect your Android phone from thieves, and what to do if it gets stolen.
blog.title: Guides and tutorials
blog.lead: Practical guides to protect your Android phone from thieves, and what to do if it gets stolen.
blog.ctaText: CrookCatcher takes a photo of anyone who enters the wrong PIN, pattern or password, and emails it to you with their location. Free on Android.

takePicture.title: Take pictures
takePicture.description: Take a picture when a wrong password, pin or pattern is entered.

location.title: Obtain location
location.description: Locate phone with GPS when picture is taken.

email.title: Send alert email
email.description: Receive pictures and location by email.

video.title: Video capture
video.description: With video capture you are more likely to get a good view of the intruder and possibly identify their voice and surroundings.

drive.title: Google Drive upload
drive.description: Upload pictures and videos directly to your Google Drive to allow easy access to files on any device.

backCamera.title: Back facing camera
backCamera.description: Identify the surroundings of the intruder with pictures from the back facing camera.

alertMessage.title: Alert Message
alertMessage.description: Show a custom message on the lock screen, when a picture is taken. You could tell the crook to return your phone, or you'll show their picture to the police.

soundAlarm.title: Alarm sound
soundAlarm.description: Play a custom alarm sound at full volume when a wrong password is entered.

fakeHomeScreen.title: Fake home screen
fakeHomeScreen.description: Show a fake home screen when a wrong password is entered. Thieves will think they unlocked your phone. When they start tapping on the screen, more pictures will be taken.

appLock.title: App lock
appLock.description: Lock access to CrookCatcher with a pattern code.

disguiseApp.title: Disguise app
disguiseApp.description: Change the app icon and name to make it look like a file explorer app, so intruders won't find out you have CrookCatcher installed.

breakIn.title: Break in detection
breakIn.description: Take a picture and send alert email if the crook guesses the right password after having failed.

emailSubject.title: Custom email subject
emailSubject.description: Change alert email subject text, to avoid crooks seeing revealing notifications.

hideNotifications.title: Hide notifications
hideNotifications.description: Only show alert notifications on device after successful unlock. This way crooks won't know they got caught.

noAds.title: No ads
noAds.description: Enjoy an ad-free app and support the development of CrookCatcher.

appCta.title: Get a photo of anyone who tries to unlock your phone
appCta.text: CrookCatcher takes an intruder selfie after a wrong PIN, pattern or password and emails it to you with the location.
